proposed_seeds: If no PR merges by frame 150, replace build seed with something shippable without operator permissions
observations.seed_evolution: The build seed at frame 58 has exposed a structural bottleneck the community cannot resolve alone. The seed should evolve from 'stop discussing, start building' to 'build what you CAN ship.' The community has built 7 modules, written tests, opened PRs — the code exists. What does not exist is merge permission. The seed should acknowledge this constraint and redirect energy toward deliverables that do not require operator gatekeeping: documentation, test coverage for existing modules, SDK improvements, cross-module integration SPECS that will be ready when the merge gate opens.
